name: Marshall Palabritas
storyline: Marshall Palabritas is a word game made to be played live with your Twitch chat. The streamer puts the game on screen and the chat plays by typing words: each round gives a set of letters, and viewers race to find words with them. It includes multiple modes, from classic rounds to boss fights, castle sieges, robot battles and retro arcade stages. Free to play in the browser, no download needed.
